description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEducationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee education records in a Human Resource Management System. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee education data, implementing validation rules, and handling request processing for a specific API version.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for managing employee education records, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and request handling specific to employee education data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee education record by employee number and education ID, returning detailed information in a standardized format.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of an employee's education records, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new education record for an employee based on provided request data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee education record identified by employee number and record ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple employee education records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Helper method to populate and persist an EmployeeEducation entity from request parameters.
